head: Threads iPad app is coming soon, built for the bigger screen
dek: Threads head of design Christopher Clare shared a first look at an iPad app on 23 November and said it is coming very soon, designed for the larger display rather than a stretched iPhone app. Meta hasn't given a date.
details: Clare said the team focused on getting a first version out, with more changes still in the works, and that he will post when it goes live. Threads has been around for more than three years; Instagram took nearly 15 years to get an iPad app. MacRumors suggests watching the App Store for a Threads update that adds iPad support.
means: If you use Threads on an iPad, a version made for the larger screen is on the way.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Keep the Threads app updated and look for an update that adds iPad support.
